name: Embroidery from a Cloud Collar: Ocean, Rocks, and Peonies
material: silk and silver thread, silvered paper; needleloop embroidery
summary: Against a deep blue satin ground, a peony tree emerges from an undulating sea. This embroidery was made using the needle looping technique, in which rows of detached loops are worked over silvered paper, attaching the ground only along the contours of the design.
